audit_target: PDF UI Freeze Baseline Forensic Measurement
root_causes_identified: Root Cause A: Synchronous pypdf.PdfReader and page.extract_text() executed on Qt GUI thread in chat_view.py _submit_prompt()
Root Cause B: Arbitrary 7500 char cutoff silently drops pages 13-24 of the 24-page PDF without user notification
Root Cause C: ChatBubble.append_token calls setMarkdown() on every single streamed token chunk, causing O(N^2) markdown re-parsing and layout reflows
Root Cause D: GUI event loop starved for up to 25+ ms per token during deep reasoning generation, triggering Windows Not Responding state
Root Cause E: No background QThread worker, no progress state machine, no cancellation propagation
